extra.question: List the post IDs and badge names of the user Samuel in 2013.
extra.evidence: Samuel refers to UserDisplayName; YEAR(CreationDate) = 2013 relates to PostId; YEAR(Date) = 2013 relates to the badge;
extra.question_with_evidence: List the post IDs and badge names of the user Samuel in 2013. Hint: Samuel refers to UserDisplayName; YEAR(CreationDate) = 2013 relates to PostId; YEAR(Date) = 2013 relates to the badge;
extra.SQL: SELECT T1.PostId, T2.Name FROM postHistory AS T1 INNER JOIN badges AS T2 ON T1.UserId = T2.UserId WHERE T1.UserDisplayName = 'Samuel' AND STRFTIME('%Y', T1.CreationDate) = '2013' AND STRFTIME('%Y', T2.Date) = '2013'
